packages/opencode-plugin/zonoid.ts has no /ready call after cooperative-stop merge

title: OpenCode ready nudge parity gap
summary: OpenCode plugin docs (last updated June 17, 2026) list plugin `tool.execute.after`, `todo.updated`, and session events. Current Zonoid OpenCode plugin registers workspace, prompt context, cooperative stop, write gate, lifecycle, task_create, and schedule_wakeup, but does not call `GET /ready` from any plugin event. Adapter contract currently leaves OpenCode ready nudge as optional plugin event; to reach parity with Claude/Codex, implement a best-effort `/ready?session=&workspace=` nudge after OpenCode tool execution and relevant ready-producing events without blocking the agent when the daemon is unavailable.
